purpose: Distill the positive-hand compact-flexible analytic prior and iteratively enrich valid, locally improvable nfp=8,nc=3 starts.

teacher.storage: two immutable float32 physical-token NPY shards plus verified manifest

distillation.normalization: geometry statistics from teacher train split; current scale is mean absolute base-coil current
distillation.current_contract: all q0 teacher currents are equal; the learned channel remains available for Adam-produced relative current allocation
distillation.seeding: model, per-rank training noise, epoch order, coil permutation, validation, and generation-monitor streams are recorded deterministic functions of the run seed
distillation.convergence: validation plateau with 0.3% relative improvement threshold and patience 10, plus three stable generated-distribution checks
distillation.maximum_epochs: 5000 runaway safety bound only; reaching it without the convergence gate fails the job

online_round.invalid: retain represented start, skip Adam, assign weight 0.05
online_round.valid: run Adam20 and use the best valid endpoint from steps 0 through 20
online_round.valid_weight: bounded to [1,2] by within-round/replay best-score rank
online_round.optimizer_state: Raw training weights and AdamW moments persist across policy rounds after a fresh round-0 online optimizer; EMA weights define the sampled policy

adam20.axis_and_score_gate: global screening axis reused at optimizer step 0 with score tolerance 0.1

resources.teacher_generation: 16 P107 CPU cores plus 24 Students CPU cores
resources.distillation_and_online: four P107 RTX5090 GPUs and 16 CPU cores

default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
